title: Bo Nix had ‘clean up’ work on ankle; still expected to be ready for training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bo Nix had ‘clean up’ work on ankle; still expected to be ready for training camp
sources.description: Reports have emerged that Bo Nix has had ‘clean up’ work done on his ankle, but it should not impact his ability to be ready for the season at all.
